scope: all persisted attempts of registered cases; live scan is not atomic

affected_attempts.reason: Returned completion failed in reasoning_history.remember before its llm event; preceding logged response is not this response.

note: Recorded token sums are lower bounds. Unknown response/failed-request usage is not zero; provider pricing is unknown.
attempt_count_note: Failed attempt receipts include retries before successful responses and terminal API errors. Do not add the terminal api_error event count to receipt counts; these overlap. Receipts do not include absolute attempt timestamps; response-event time is not failure time.
